attribute_fields.COMMENTS: American Samoa territory income tax calculation. AS uses frozen IRC as of year 2000. Bona fide residents with only AS-source income file only with ASG per IRC 931. SPECIAL RULE: Must pay US self-employment tax if SE income >= $400, even if filing only with ASG. US nationals (not citizens) from AS have unique status.

initial_action.action_postfix: "AMERICAN SAMOA TERRITORY TAX - Frozen IRC (2000)" job.audit_trail swap addto " Special SE tax rules apply" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.as_income_tax xdef 0.0 /result.as_se_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Bona fide resident of American Samoa
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.as_days_present 183 >= result.as_has_tax_home and result.as_closer_connection and dup /result.as_bona_fide_resident xdef

action_details.action_comment: Bona fide resident with only AS income and SE tax requirement
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.as_files_with_asg xdef true /result.as_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.as_income_tax xdef
result.self_employment_tax /result.as_se_tax xdef
" Bona fide AS resident with only AS-source income" job.audit_trail swap addto " Files ONLY with ASG for income tax per IRC 931" job.audit_trail swap addto " SPECIAL RULE: Must pay US self-employment tax (SE income >= $400)" job.audit_trail swap addto " AS income tax: $" result.as_income_tax cvs strconcat " (to ASG)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " US SE tax: $" result.as_se_tax cvs strconcat " (to IRS)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Bona fide resident with only AS income, no SE tax
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.as_files_with_asg xdef false /result.as_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.as_income_tax xdef 0.0 /result.as_se_tax xdef
" Bona fide AS resident with only AS-source income" job.audit_trail swap addto " Files ONLY with ASG (no IRS filing required)" job.audit_trail swap addto " No US self-employment tax (SE income < $400)" job.audit_trail swap addto " AS income tax: $" result.as_income_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Not bona fide resident or has US income - files with IRS
action_details.action_postfix:
false /result.as_bona_fide_resident xdef true /result.as_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.as_income_tax xdef result.self_employment_tax /result.as_se_tax xdef
" Not bona fide AS resident or has US-source income" job.audit_trail swap addto " Files with IRS for all income" job.audit_trail swap addto " Total tax: $" result.as_income_tax result.as_se_tax f+ cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Bona fide AS resident with only AS income must pay US SE tax if SE income >= $400
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide AS residents with only AS-source income file only with ASG per IRC 931. SPECIAL RULE: Must pay US self-employment tax to IRS if self-employment income >= $400, even though exempt from US income tax. Uses frozen IRC as of 2000."

policy_statement.policy_description: Bona fide AS resident with only AS income, no SE tax requirement
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide AS residents with only AS-source income and SE income < $400 file only with ASG. No IRS filing required. Exempt from US income tax on AS-source income per IRC 931."

policy_statement.policy_description: Non-bona fide resident or has US income - files with IRS
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Non-bona fide AS residents or those with US-source income file with IRS and pay US income tax and SE tax. Must meet bona fide residence test and have only AS-source income to qualify for IRC 931 exclusion."
